LanguageData.HD_Company_FinancialDesc: Request the financial caravan operated by National Industrial Credit Corporation. Requires an allied LOW faction. Each request costs 15 goodwill and one primary cell; arrival takes 1–2 days. This company has its own four-day request cooldown.
LanguageData.HD_Company_CommercialDesc: Request the commercial caravan operated by Central Hardware & Supply Co. Requires an allied LOW faction. Each request costs 15 goodwill and one primary cell; arrival takes 1–2 days. This company has its own four-day request cooldown.
LanguageData.HD_Company_PioneerDesc: Arrange LOW Helod forward base construction, review signed contracts, and request services from contracted forward bases.
LanguageData.HD_Company_HarringtonDesc: Hire six elite caravan guards, including one elite guard captain, for one day of colony assistance. The team enters from the map edge. Price: 500 Sthaler and one primary cell. Rehire is available after one day.
LanguageData.HD_Company_RequestBoth: Request financial and commercial caravans together
